private_ownership_cleanup: One cached synthetic fixture ID is written privately0600 outside both checkouts, never published. Post-exit fixed hosted Unix-socket GET/version (capped16KiB internal only) plus exact-ID inspect only; HTTP404 after successful discovery =>CONFIRMED_ABSENT, found=>PRESENT, missing/error/timeout=>UNKNOWN. record_properties: All normal events include integer monotonic elapsed ms only. No wall timestamps, frame locals, args, SQL text, paths, PID, owner identity, exception text, token, health value or data body.
activation: Qualification is per-process and per-target protocol, never global any-record union: exactly one target protocol, same-process collection, body activation point1, one held-probe return and restoration after setup/call/teardown reports. Source points unique per target, held returns<=1. Missing/partial/setup failure/ambiguous witnesses remain UNKNOWN.

receipt_lifecycle.elapsed: integer ms >=0 and nondecreasing per process; original upper bound unchanged
receipt_lifecycle.per_process: exactly one initial configure and final footer, at most one collection/restoration; collection before protocols; footer collection/trace flags match that process records; fault flags retain UNKNOWN
receipt_lifecycle.target: all target point/held-return/restoration records must occur inside that same process target protocol before restoration; no point/return after restoration/footer; duplicate points/returns/restoration/protocols refused
receipt_lifecycle.population: one protocol per each of six native identities plus existing unique18 phase reports; target setup/call/teardown must precede its restoration; idle controller/worker streams allowed with consistent flags
receipt_lifecycle.no_point_sequence: No demand for all34 points or numeric point ordering; point IDs are names. Fixture points may precede body activation. Return must have actual target body activation in that lifecycle.
receipt_lifecycle.qualified_summary_flags: Summary activation/collection/restoration flags describe a qualified correlated target lifecycle, not isolated raw record existence. Raw closed records and UNKNOWN reasons remain retained.
receipt_lifecycle.partial: Interrupted/missing traces or genuine setup/fixture failure may still preserve records, but observation_complete=false. No ordinary test or original both-offset admission.
